description: This Java source file defines the CommandStrategyProvider class, which provides the appropriate CommandStrategy based on the 'method' and 'resourceUrl' of incoming requests. It uses Spring's ApplicationContext to load CommandStrategy beans and maintains a map of CommandContext to strategy bean names for routing. It includes various regex patterns for URL matching and defines a set of command strategies for different API endpoints related to clients, loans, savings accounts, charges, datatables, and interest pauses.

classes.name: CommandStrategyProvider
classes.description: Provider class that determines and supplies the appropriate CommandStrategy based on request context

methods.name: getCommandStrategy
methods.description: Returns an appropriate CommandStrategy based on CommandContext, supporting versioned and non-versioned paths

methods.name: internalGetCommandStrategy
methods.description: Looks up the CommandStrategy in the map or matches the context, defaults to UnknownCommandStrategy if not found

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the commandStrategies map with predefined URL patterns and strategy bean names
